badge: Experia Education Hackathon · The School of 2036
heroBody: Students learn any subject through real-life missions, level up like a game, and evaluate each other like 42 School. Teachers guide, parents take part, and Bousla the AI coach helps everyone.
f1Body: Measure your building with shadows, tile your bedroom, interview a grandparent. Learning that answers “when will I ever use this?”.
f2Body: XP, levels, streaks, badges and a skill map that lights up as you master each topic. No shame, ever: “Almost! Here's what to fix.”
f3Body: Like 42 School, students evaluate each other with an AI checklist, earn evaluation points and grow as teachers too.
roleStudent: Students go on missions and level up.
roleTeacher: Teachers import classes from Google Classroom, generate safe missions with AI and see who is stuck.
roleParent: Parents get a weekly summary in their language and do family missions.
roleDirector: Directors see real learning across the school.
footer: Built for the Experia Education Hackathon · Beirut 2026
